# Diagrams

Draw architecture diagrams with Mermaid. Example:

```mermaid
graph TD
  A[Client] --> B[API]
  B --> C[(Database)]
```

Embed the logo as ![logo](data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk).
